title: Attack-matrix — executed where a named check exists; contract-only otherwise
spec: cr.nonce.consume-and-commit.v1 (receipt-verifier/test/consume-and-commit-vectors.json) + capability-demo/demo/src/atomic.js + git-atomic.js + http-atomic.js + reconcile.js + guard 14 cas-attestation
honesty:
The runner EXECUTES a vector only when the row names an execute id that maps to a shipped adapter (capability-demo git-atomic / http-atomic / reconcile). COVERED means all five points (target, nonce, executor, attestation, gate) were checked by that run — not that the JSON declared an expected outcome. A vector with no execute id stays NOT_RUN, named; it is never silently COVERED. The runner does not invent a verifier, does not mint grants, and does not call issueExecutionGrant (Guard 14 still does not export it). Stated-contract consumeAndCommit rows remain contract: the public receipt-verifier is STATELESS and cannot detect a replayed jti. ATOMIC_COMMIT stays NOT_COVERED — fail-closed adapter/reconciler regressions are not nonce+CAS+attestation as one transaction.

WHAT A STATED-CONTRACT ROW ASSERTS: the named attack, if presented to a production consumeAndCommit, MUST produce the recorded outcome, error code, and target-unchanged invariant. The names are measured from shipped contracts (EP-2 consume-and-commit-vectors.json and capability-demo atomic.js), not invented. Recording is not execution.

WHAT A PENDING-CONTRACT ROW ASSERTS: the outcome cannot be stated without a data plane (running host, overlapping grant issuance, or live CAS). Recorded with why, not executed.

WHAT AN EXECUTABLE ROW ASSERTS: lib/attack-matrix-runner.js ran the named check against the shipped adapter and observed the five points. That is COVERED-by-execution.

SIBLING, NOT excluded[]: fixtures/adversarial.v1.json excluded[] remains exactly four (raw_tool_beside_guarded_table, concurrent_grants, stale_nonce, ruleset_bypass). This file does not enlarge that list.

error_code_sources.NONCE_ALREADY_CONSUMED: receipt-verifier/test/consume-and-commit-vectors.json CAC-REPLAY (EP-2 contract). Guard 14 does not define this symbol. capability-demo today emits GRANT_CONSUMED (demo/src/atomic.js:82, PG 23505 on consumed_grants.jti).
error_code_sources.NONCE_EXPIRED: receipt-verifier CAC-EXPIRED. Demo today emits STATE_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED (atomic.js:56).
error_code_sources.TARGET_STATE_CONFLICT: receipt-verifier CAC-TARGET-STATE-CONFLICT. Demo today emits STATE_DRIFT (atomic.js:68).
error_code_sources.authorized_and_committed: NOT an error code. Guard 14 cas-attestation.ts:431-435: under ENFORCING_ATOMIC, authorized_and_committed is true only when cas_evidence.class === 'executor_attested'.

attacks.why_pending: Property of a RUNNING host's tool table. Same reason as adversarial.v1.json excluded raw_tool_beside_guarded_table. Every subject here is a pure function of case input with no host. A fake host would weaken @coderifts/bypass-probe.

attacks.why_stated: EP-2 consume-and-commit-vectors.json CAC-REPLAY already names the outcome. Demo atomic.js:73-82 implements the one-use as consumed_grants.jti PRIMARY KEY (23505 → GRANT_CONSUMED). No executor runs here; the contract is recorded.
attacks.target_unchanged_invariant: A replayed nonce MUST NOT apply a second mutation. The whole transaction rolls back (demo atomic.js:8, 80-82).

attacks.why_pending: Requires ISSUING overlapping execution grants. Guard 14.0.0 exports 213 symbols, executeIfUnchanged is a function, issueExecutionGrant is undefined. tryIssue* are attestations, not grants. Same reason as excluded concurrent_grants. Cannot reproduce 8 overlapping issuances offline.

Verifying the target stayed unchanged needs a live executor CAS against challenged digest. Demo implements it (atomic.js:62-70 STATE_DRIFT); EP-2 names TARGET_STATE_CONFLICT. This suite does not run either. Outcome names are recorded below so they are not invented later; the row stays pending until a data plane exists.
attacks.maps_to_excluded: stale_nonce (adjacent: nonce consumption is the executor; CAS drift is STATE_DRIFT / TARGET_STATE_CONFLICT)

attacks.why_stated: EP-2 CAC-EXPIRED names NONCE_EXPIRED. Demo atomic.js:54-56 refuses expired challenges as STATE_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED before the ledger insert, so the mutation never runs.
attacks.target_unchanged_invariant: An expired nonce MUST NOT mutate. Demo rolls back before INSERT consumed_grants and before mutate().

attacks.why_stated: EP-2 CAC-PAYLOAD-SWAP: mutation after_payload_hash disagrees with the grant binding → PAYLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH. Guard 14 does not define this symbol (no nonce ledger). The contract is the EP-2 name.
attacks.target_unchanged_invariant: A swapped after-payload MUST NOT commit. The grant is bound to after-payload (scope_hash); a different body is a different grant.

attacks.why_stated: Guard 14 cas-attestation.ts:431-435 (ENFORCING_ATOMIC): authorized_and_committed is true only when cas_evidence.class === 'executor_attested'. Host-claimed commit becomes authorized_and_host_reported_committed, never authorized_and_committed. This is a document-label invariant of the shipped guard, not a running executor. Conformance does not call buildCasAttestation; the contract is recorded.
attacks.target_unchanged_note: Missing attestation does NOT imply the mutation was refused. Host-claimed means the host reported a commit without executor attestation. The invariant is the LABEL, not the bytes on disk.

attacks.why_executable: capability-demo git-atomic.js refuses a missing expected_old_sha BEFORE any update-ref (AUDIT P0 HIBA-1). The runner calls the shipped adapter; it does not reimplement CAS.
capability-demo http-atomic.js refuses UPDATE-intent with a missing or weak ETag BEFORE PUT (AUDIT P0 HIBA-3). The runner calls the shipped adapter against a local origin that sends no ETag.
capability-demo reconcile.js never CONFIRMED a forged attestation (AUDIT P0). The runner calls reconcile() with attestation:"not-a-token" against a stub origin — the shipped verifier, not a new one.
